title: Beal Conjecture — a conditionally complete formal assembly
description: A conditionally complete Lean 4 assembly of a level-26 route toward the Beal Conjecture. The final theorem exposes exactly five named premises. The finite mod-3 matrix is ledger-derived; the q-expansion/cotangent compatibility with the actual Abel-Jacobi differential remains explicit. Selmer cardinality is proved only for an explicitly supplied carrier whose cohomological identification remains external.
